title: Violent Clashes Erupt in South African Cities Over Immigration
summary: Protests against immigration have turned violent in Johannesburg and Durban, South Africa. The protests began with demands for the deportation of undocumented foreigners, who were given a deadline to leave by June 30. The clashes resulted in injuries and property damage. The situation remains tense as authorities try to maintain order.
summary_points: Protests against immigration have turned violent in Johannesburg and Durban, South Africa
The protests began with demands for the deportation of undocumented foreigners
The deadline for undocumented foreigners to leave was set by anti-migrant groups
Violent clashes resulted in injuries and property damage
Authorities are trying to maintain order in the situation
